Item 1. Business

We design accelerated computing platforms. Our GPU products power artificial intelligence training and inference workloads across hyperscale data center customers. Demand for accelerated computing continues to broaden as generative AI moves from research into production deployment. Our CUDA software platform and AI software stack are used by developers building large language model applications. We also serve gaming, professional visualization, robotics and autonomous vehicle markets. The AI data center opportunity remains the largest driver of our business, supported by AI infrastructure buildouts among cloud computing providers. Semiconductor supply is sourced from third party foundry partners.We design accelerated computing platforms. The AI data center opportunity remains the largest driver of our business, supported by AI infrastructure buildouts among cloud computing providers. Semiconductor supply is sourced from third party foundry partners.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our business depends on demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure, which may not grow as expected. Export control regulations restrict sales of certain accelerated computing products to some regions, and additional export restrictions could reduce revenue. We depend on a limited number of foundry partners; supply chain disruption or capacity constraints could impair our ability to meet demand. Customer concentration is significant: a small number of hyperscale data center customers account for a large share of revenue. Competition in semiconductors and AI software is intense. Power demand and grid capacity constraints at data center sites may delay customer deployments.Our business depends on demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure, which may not grow as expected. Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition

Revenue growth was driven by data center demand for AI training systems. Gross margin expanded on favorable product mix. We continue to invest in AI software and GPU roadmap execution.
